title: [GR-37091] Ensure NativeImageDebugLineInfo#ownerType returns the unwrapped type

timeline.message:
Ensure NativeImageDebugLineInfo#ownerType returns the unwrapped type

This prevents `ClassEntry`s from appearing twice in the `primaryClasses`
list which is indexed (in `primaryClassesIndex`) using the type.

Fix #4328
timeline.author: Foivos Zakkak

@olpaw please have a look at https://github.com/oracle/graal/issues/4328#issuecomment-1043188745 before reviewing.

> @olpaw please have a look at [#4328 (comment)](https://github.com/oracle/graal/issues/4328#issuecomment-1043188745) before reviewing.

I understand @adinn's comment as an approve from his side.

> I understand @adinn's comment as an approve from his side.

It's a guarded approval. As well as the concern that the compilation result metadata model is throwing up AnalysisXXX types I have a secondary concern about a possible corner case.

Foivos's patch ensures that any AnalysisMethod that sneaks into the call chain is unwrapped to the underlying ResolvedJavaMethod before retrieving the declaring class. That ensures that we don't end up recording both an AnalysisClass and a HotspotResolvedJavaClassImpl for org.my.Foo.

The corner case would be where the AnalysisMethod actually identifies a SubstitionMethod. In that case it's declaring class will be Target_org_my_Foo. This does not lead to the error where there are two classes with the same name. However, it means that a method that is supposed to be collated with all other methods of org.my.Foo ends up being indexed off an independent class Target_org_my_Foo.

The problem we are seeing at present is not that corner case. However, I'd eventually like to fix this so that the possibility is removed.
